saw_lines: Buyers of resin and floor coatings research one project at a time, comparing finishes and colors before they order.
So the sale is won or lost on the offer and proof, which a buyer checks before choosing a finish.
Your 23 copy ads carry no proof number, so put one real count, your review count or orders shipped, on every creative and open the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: None of your 23 copy ads shows a proof number, so a first-time buyer has nothing to trust. Put one real count on every creative, your review count or orders shipped, and open the next batch with it.
None of your 23 copy ads mentions an offer, so a new buyer has no reason to order today. Put one first order offer in the opening line of three ads and test a two-pack bundle against it.

Your 23 copy ads open with 16 different stories, and the biggest leads only 2 of them, so no message repeats enough to sink in. Pick the two strongest openings and build the next batch from them, three variations each.

30 ads have run 60 days or more, and the oldest, the floor coating ad, has been live since June 2023. Build three variations of that floor ad for garage, workshop and home floors, and run them beside it.

ads_1: Floor and resin hook variations, each opening with a first order offer
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube
